# CORE

> > The world's largest aggregator of open access research papers, providing infrastructure and services for scholarly communication and research discovery.

CORE is a mission-driven non-profit organization that indexes millions of open access research outputs from repositories worldwide. The platform offers APIs, datasets, and tools for researchers, institutions, and organizations to discover, manage, and share research outputs.

## Key Topics

- open access
- open research
- scholarly infrastructure
- repository indexing
- CORE API
- CORE Dataset

## Core Services

- [CORE Services Overview](https://core.ac.uk/services): Overview of CORE services: API, Dataset, FastSync, and Recommender solutions
- [CORE API](https://core.ac.uk/services): API access for programmatic querying and integration with CORE's open access research collection
- [CORE Dataset](https://core.ac.uk/services): Large-scale dataset of open access research outputs for research and analysis
- [CORE Recommender](https://core.ac.uk/services/recommender): Leading research paper recommendation solution powered by machine learning
- [CORE FastSync](https://core.ac.uk/services/fastsync): Data synchronization service using ResourceSync protocol for efficient repository updates
- [CORE Dashboard](https://core.ac.uk/services/repository-dashboard): Repository management tool to monitor outputs, track visibility, and optimize discoverability

## Repository Integration & Technical Standards

- [OAI Resolver](https://core.ac.uk/documentation/oai-resolver): OAI Resolver documentation: persistent identifiers and OAI-PMH standards for metadata harvesting
- [Repository Indexing](https://core.ac.uk/faq): FAQs on repository indexing protocols and joining CORE's aggregation network

## Membership & Partnership

- [CORE Membership](https://core.ac.uk/membership): Membership pricing plans and benefits for data providers, institutions, and organizations
- [CORE Sponsorship](https://core.ac.uk/sponsorship): Sponsorship opportunities at multiple funding levels to support open research infrastructure
- [CORE Consultancy](https://core.ac.uk/services/consultancy): Professional services for research data analysis and scholarly communication strategy
